situation: A resident stands in an apartment hallway pulling a white paper envelope out of a metal wall-mounted mailbox.
subject: the paper envelope
brief: A woman's hand reaches into a rectangular metal letterbox slot on a painted hallway wall, gripping a crisp white paper envelope with a visible postage stamp corner. The flat shapes of the wall and the clean, graphic lines of the mail slot frame the bright envelope as the central object.
prompt: A woman's hand reaches into a rectangular metal letterbox slot on a painted hallway wall, gripping a crisp white paper envelope with a visible postage stamp corner. The flat shapes of the wall and the clean, graphic lines of the mail slot frame the bright envelope as the central object. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
